SELECT batter, (SUM(CASE WHEN batsman_runs IN (4, 6) THEN batsman_runs ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(batsman_runs)) AS boundary_percentage
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 500
ORDER BY boundary_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT batter FROM deliveries GROUP BY batter HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 1000)

SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS ball_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE COALESCE(extras_type, '') NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs', 'wide', 'noball')
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY ball_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY match_id, batter
ORDER BY runs DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT m.winner AS team, COUNT(*) AS wins
FROM matches m
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT match_id, batting_team AS bat_first
  FROM deliveries
  WHERE inning = 1
) d ON m.id = d.match_id
WHERE m.winner IS NOT NULL AND m.winner != d.bat_first
GROUP BY m.winner
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(total_runs) FROM deliveries WHERE "over" BETWEEN 0 AND 5
SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) AS runs FROM deliveries WHERE "over" BETWEEN 15 AND 19 GROUP BY batter ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type IS NULL OR extras_type != 'wides' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS strike_rate
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING SUM(batsman_runs) >= 300
ORDER BY strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bowler, SUM(batsman_runs + CASE WHEN extras_type IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN extra_runs ELSE 0 END) * 6.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type IS NULL OR extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS economy
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type IS NULL OR extras_type NOT IN ('wides', 'noballs') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1000
ORDER BY economy ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bowler, SUM(CASE WHEN extras_type IN ('byes', 'legbyes') THEN 0 ELSE total_runs END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN is_wicket = 1 AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY bowler
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN is_wicket = 1 AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 30
ORDER BY average ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH team_runs AS (
  SELECT m.season, d.batting_team AS team, SUM(d.total_runs) AS runs
  FROM deliveries d
  JOIN matches m ON d.match_id = m.id
  GROUP BY m.season, d.batting_team
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT season, team, runs,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY season ORDER BY runs DESC) AS rn
  FROM team_runs
)
SELECT season, team, runs
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY season

SELECT batter, SUM(batsman_runs) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS avg_runs_per_match
FROM deliveries
GROUP BY batter
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) >= 30
ORDER BY avg_runs_per_match DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT m.winner, SUM(d.total_runs) AS second_innings_total
FROM matches m
JOIN deliveries d ON m.id = d.match_id
WHERE d.inning = 2 AND m.winner = d.batting_team
GROUP BY m.id, m.winner
ORDER BY second_innings_total DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) AS wicket_count
FROM deliveries
WHERE over BETWEEN 15 AND 19
  AND is_wicket = 1
  AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field')
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY wicket_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT batter, COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
FROM deliveries
WHERE batter NOT IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT player_dismissed
  FROM deliveries
  WHERE player_dismissed IS NOT NULL
)
GROUP BY batter
ORDER BY balls_faced DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN toss_decision = 'field' AND toss_winner = winner THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage FROM matches

WITH team_matches AS (
  SELECT team1 AS team, winner FROM matches WHERE season = '2023'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT team2 AS team, winner FROM matches WHERE season = '2023'
),
team_stats AS (
  SELECT
    team,
    COUNT(*) AS played,
    SUM(CASE WHEN team = winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins
  FROM team_matches
  GROUP BY team
)
SELECT
  team,
  wins * 100.0 / played AS win_percentage
FROM team_stats
WHERE played >= 5
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT bowler, player_dismissed AS batter, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM deliveries
WHERE is_wicket = 1
  AND dismissal_kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
GROUP BY bowler, player_dismissed
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 1

) si ON fi.match_id = si.match_id

WITH first_batting AS (
  SELECT match_id, MIN(batting_team) AS team1_bat
  FROM deliveries
  WHERE inning = 1
  GROUP BY match_id
)
SELECT m.winner AS team, COUNT(*) AS wins
FROM matches m
JOIN first_batting fb ON m.id = fb.match_id
WHERE m.winner IS NOT NULL
  AND m.winner <> fb.team1_bat
GROUP BY m.winner
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 1

ranked AS (

WITH matches_2023 AS (
  SELECT * FROM matches WHERE season = '2023'
),
team_matches AS (
  SELECT team1 AS team FROM matches_2023
  UNION ALL
  SELECT team2 AS team FROM matches_2023
),
team_stats AS (
  SELECT
    tm.team,
    COUNT(*) AS matches_played,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner = tm.team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins
  FROM team_matches tm
  JOIN matches_2023 m
    ON tm.team = m.team1 OR tm.team = m.team2
  GROUP BY tm.team
)
SELECT
  team,
  ROUND(100.0 * wins / matches_played, 2) AS win_percentage
FROM team_stats
WHERE matches_played >= 5
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 1

    SELECT DISTINCT match_id, batting_team
    FROM deliveries
    WHERE inning = 2
) AS inn2 ON inn1.match_id = inn2.match_id
JOIN matches m ON m.id = inn1.match_id

),

  SELECT

  SELECT team1 AS team FROM matches WHERE season = '2023'

  SELECT team2 AS team FROM matches WHERE season = '2023'
),
team_match_counts AS (
  SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS matches_played
  FROM all_teams_2023
  GROUP BY team
),
team_win_counts AS (
  SELECT winner AS team, COUNT(*) AS wins
  FROM matches
  WHERE season = '2023' AND winner IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY winner
)

       (COALESCE(twc.wins, 0) * 100.0 / tmc.matches_played) AS win_percentage
FROM team_match_counts tmc

SELECT AVG(first_innings_total) AS avg_first_innings_total
FROM (
    SELECT d.match_id, SUM(d.total_runs) AS first_innings_total
    FROM deliveries d
    WHERE d.inning = 1
    AND d.match_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT d2.match_id
        FROM deliveries d2
        JOIN matches m ON d2.match_id = m.id
        WHERE d2.inning = 2 AND d2.batting_team = m.winner
    )
    GROUP BY d.match_id
)
